dkan_dataset\/9df04c5f-6558-4c4f-a802-d8.title: Telangana Irrigation & CAD Department – Daily Reservoir Storage Levels
dkan_dataset\/9df04c5f-6558-4c4f-a802-d8.description:
Organisation: The Telangana Irrigation & CAD Department

Data available from January 2021 to July 2026 

This dataset provides information about the daily reservoir storage levels details in Telangana.

Contains the below columns: | date | reservoir_name | basin_name | frl | capacity | level_in_feet |

Abbreviation: 

  1. Date: Date
  2. reservior_name: reservoir name
  3. basin_name: basin name
  4. frl: Full Tank Level in Mtrs
  5. capacity:  in TMC
  6. level_in_feet_present: in Mtrs
  7. gross_storage: in  TMC
  8. inflow: Water inflow measured in cusecs
  9. outflow: Water outflow measured in cusecs
